findingsAndFixes.finding: Isolated session loaded zero extensions with no error: Pi 1.x isExtensionFile accepts only .ts/.js, and the launcher wrote .mjs shims that were silently skipped.
findingsAndFixes.fix: scripts/pi1-dev.sh now writes wayforge.js/pi-subagents.js shims and removes stale .mjs; regression tests exercise Pi's real discoverAndLoadExtensions in both directions.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Both workers failed closed with worker_model_mismatch although the engine had not changed models: pi-subagents echoes the effective child model with a :thinking suffix (applyThinkingSuffix).
findingsAndFixes.fix: Adapter compares base models, records the full observed string, and reports expected/observed in the failure message; genuinely different or missing model evidence still fails closed.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Operators had to copy workflow state out of the TUI by hand.
findingsAndFixes.fix: WorkflowDiskSink persists redacted events (JSONL) and atomic status snapshots under <PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR>/wayforge/; wiring bug (controller referenced before assignment during the first synchronous event) was caught by the extension e2e test and fixed.

findingsAndFixes.finding: Bounded review workers failed on worker_token_budget_exceeded: cumulative input across tool-using turns far exceeds the visible prompt (1.5k blocked 4/6 workers; 8k still blocked first-pass reviews).
findingsAndFixes.fix: Worker route budget calibrated to 32k and main invocation budget to 96k; session 5 completed a full review within budget.
